title: 第二百四十九章 龙尸第二百四十八章 柳如烟的猜想
slug: 听我解释真不是你们想的那样
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！第一卷：默认第二百四十九章龙尸（..la）陆沉没有开口。
柳如烟见状，沉默了一瞬，然后坦然地点了点头。
“你不用这样的表情，我从一开始就没打算炼化这两枚法则碎片。冰火双属性与我相性不合，如果我是仙人，倒是可以炼化，但现在，强行炼化只会让我爆体而亡。
所以我要考虑其他的法则碎片！这里没有，那应该就在第二重万象迷宫之中。”
她顿了顿，抬起头看向陆沉，目光坦然。
“所以，这两枚碎片，你们拿去分吧。冰属性的给静白，她本身就有阴寒体质，炼化冰属性碎片事半功倍。
火属性的你自己用，你五行灵根包容万物，炼化一枚火属性法则碎片不会有任何排斥反应。我只希望……后面若是找到木属性的法则碎片，你们能帮我一把。”
陆沉看着她，点了点头：“好，那一言为定。”
柳如烟见状，微微松了口气。
既然陆沉才是真正的天地主角，气运所在，那自己，就跟他好好结交就是了！
她正要开口，却见陆沉又蹲下身去，双手按在泉水边缘的岩石上，似乎在盘算着什么。
“你这是怎么了？”
“没什么，不过就是这口泉眼放在这里也是浪费！不如……我们直接搬走好了！毕竟这秘境下次开启，也不知道是什么时候了！”
“搬……搬走？”柳如烟以为自己听错了。
“对，搬走。”
“这冰火……本身就是天地奇物，加上周围这些灵草灵药，留在秘境里太可惜了。我打算把这一整片区域带走，以后再慢慢开发。”
柳如烟张了张嘴，想说这怎么可能搬得走，这里可是秘境空间，冰火两…扎根地下不知多少万年，根系和地脉早已融为一体，强行搬走恐怕会引发空间坍塌。
但她转念一想，陆沉身上已经有了太多的不可能变成可能，一个能让她前世记忆里，内斗一辈子的庄静白和魅姬，都能和平共处的男人，再多一件匪夷所思的事又有什么奇怪的？
“……你随意。”她最终只说了这两个字。
但接下来的事情，却让柳如烟全程目瞪口呆。

因为，陆沉将整个玄天界的空间之力催动到了极致！
只见玄天界的入口缓缓张开，先是一道细细的裂缝，然后迅速扩展到足以覆盖整片空地的大小。
一股磅礴得令人窒息的灵力从入口中涌出，化作无数只看不见的无形大手，沿着冰火两仪眼的边缘向下探去。
地面开始剧烈震动，岩石崩裂，泥土翻涌，整个泉眼连同周围百丈方圆的地面被那股空间之力硬生生地从大地中“挖”了出来。
那场面极为震撼，像是有一只无形的巨手从天空中伸下来，将整片土地连根拔起。
周围的灵草在震动中簌簌发抖，但没有一株受损，因为每一株都被一层透明的空间之力包裹着，完好无损。
当最后一寸根系从地脉中脱离的瞬间，整片土地被猛地一托，缓缓升入玄天界的入口之中。
入口合拢，一切归于平静，只留下一个深达百丈的巨大坑洞，坑壁上还残留着冰火两种属性互相冲撞后留下的焦痕和冰霜。
柳如烟站在坑洞边缘，望着那片空荡荡的深坑，沉默了好一会儿，才缓缓吐出两个字。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book lovers: Listen to my explanation, it’s really not what you think! Volume 1: Default Chapter 249 Dragon Corpse (..la) Lu Chen did not speak.
Seeing this, Liu Ruyan was silent for a moment, and then nodded calmly.
"You don't have to look like this. I had no intention of refining these two law fragments from the beginning. The dual attributes of ice and fire are incompatible with me. If I were an immortal, I could refine them, but now, forcibly refining them will only cause me to explode and die.
So I have to consider other law fragments! There isn't one here, it should be in the second layer of the maze of all things. "
She paused, raised her head and looked at Lu Chen, her eyes calm.
"So, take these two fragments and divide them. Give the ice attribute to Jingbai. She has a cold constitution, so refining the ice attribute fragments will get twice the result with half the effort.
If you use the fire attribute, you can use it yourself. Your Five Elements Spiritual Root embraces all things, and refining a fire attribute law fragment will not cause any rejection. I just hope that if I find wood-attributed law fragments later, you can help me. "
Lu Chen looked at her and nodded: "Okay, it's settled."
Seeing this, Liu Ruyan breathed a sigh of relief.
Since Lu Chen is the real protagonist of the world and where his destiny lies, then he just needs to make good friends with him!
She was about to speak when she saw Lu Chen squatting down again and pressing his hands on the rocks at the edge of the spring, as if he was thinking about something.
"What's wrong with you?"
"It's nothing, but it's a waste to keep this spring here! Why don't we just move it away! After all, I don't know when this secret realm will open next time!"
"Move...move away?" Liu Ruyan thought she heard wrongly.
"Yes, move away."
"This ice and fire... itself is a rare thing in the world, and with the surrounding spiritual herbs and elixirs, it would be a pity to leave it in the secret realm. I plan to take this entire area away and develop it slowly in the future."
Liu Ruyan opened her mouth and wondered how it was possible to move this place. This was a secret space. Ice and fire... had been rooted underground for countless thousands of years. The roots and earth veins had long been integrated into one. Forcibly moving it away might cause the space to collapse.
But then she thought about it, Lu Chen had already made too many impossible things possible. For a man who could make Zhuang Jingbai and Mei Ji, who had been fighting among themselves for a lifetime, coexist peacefully in her past life memory, what would be surprising if one more unthinkable thing happened to him?
"...It's up to you." She finally said these two words.
But what happened next left Liu Ruyan stunned the entire time.
Because Lu Chen pushed the space power of the entire Xuantian Realm to the extreme!
I saw the entrance to Xuantian Realm slowly opening, first as a thin crack, and then quickly expanded to a size large enough to cover the entire open space.
A majestic and suffocating spiritual power surged out from the entrance, turning into countless invisible invisible hands, reaching down along the edge of the Ice and Fire Eyes.
The ground began to shake violently, rocks cracked, and soil surged. The entire spring and the surrounding ground of a hundred feet were "digged" out of the earth by the force of space.
The scene was extremely shocking, as if an invisible giant hand reached down from the sky and uprooted the entire land.
The surrounding spiritual grasses trembled in the vibration, but none of them were damaged, because each one was wrapped by a layer of transparent space power and remained intact.
When the last inch of roots separated from the earth's veins, the entire land was suddenly lifted up and slowly rose into the entrance of Xuantian Realm.
The entrance was closed, and everything returned to calm, leaving only a huge pit with a depth of a hundred feet. The walls of the pit still had scorch marks and frost left by the collision of the two attributes of ice and fire.
Liu Ruyan stood on the edge of the pit, looking at the empty pit. She was silent for a while before slowly uttering two words.
